newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall, low consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall, low consumer demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Monday on low consumer demand, dealers said.
"Consumer demand was low while increased offerings by the mill owners kept the market quiet," one dealer said.

Higher offerings by the millers amid an absence of fresh outstation demand prompted more supplies in the market. In ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by 6/9 rupees to 1,241/1,288 rupees while M-30 slid by 10/25 rupees to 1,265/1,322 rupees. Sugar mill delivery slid by 10 rupees to 1,180/1,200 rupees.
